response.justification: Bogdan is an accomplished, versatile senior engineer with 13+ years of experience, strong distributed-systems and low-latency work (Dlang microservices handling millions of req/s), and a demonstrated testing/craftsmanship culture. However, the role is fundamentally a C++ systems and industrial-automation position, and his C++ exposure is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago plus a university thesis project. He shows no evidence of STL-heavy modern C++, message brokers in a C++ context, MQTT/OPC UA/Modbus, IEC 62443 or SDL secure-engineering practice, or industrial automation domain knowledge. His profile is web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS), which maps only to the 'advantageous' portion of the requirements rather than the core competencies. Onboarding cost for the core stack would be high relative to other likely applicants.
strengths: Deep experience with high-throughput, low-latency distributed and event-driven systems
Broad polyglot background including embedded, desktop, and backend work; strong TDD/CI/CD discipline
Proven mentoring and technical communication via workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: Minimal and dated C++/STL experience (~7 months in 2014-2015); no modern C++ evidence
No industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL secure development, or OT protocol experience (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA)
Recent career trajectory is web/full-stack and AI tooling, not systems-level C++ platform engineering

key_factors.factor: Distributed, concurrent, high-performance systems track record
